correctness.evidence: Independent 8! enumeration gives exactly 64 and 192 transversals; every listed 8-way partition was checked cell-by-cell and yields an orthogonal Latin mate.

originality.evidence: The order-8 K3,3-free classification and earlier universally noncommutative-loop paper report other symmetry invariants but no transversal counts, disjoint-transversal packings, or orthogonal-mate verdicts for this pair.

value.evidence: The result resolves a natural orthogonality question for the complete rare order-8 class and supplies explicit partitions/mates plus a new numerical separator between the two classes.
